entries.complaint: Coating flakes within weeks or months, sometimes after one wash; users worry about eating the flakes
entries.redesign: Swappable coated insert on a durable stainless or cast body, a wear-indicator layer that changes color before bare metal shows, and an honest 'replace insert by' lifespan on the box
entries.prior_art: Stainless or carbon-steel baskets; replaceable-liner air fryers

entries.complaint: Mesh and crevices trap grease; the basket is hard to fully clean
entries.redesign: Flat perforated tray with no mesh and no internal seams, rounded inside corners, and a lift-out drip pan that goes in the dishwasher

entries.complaint: A row of knobs controls a 2×2 grid of burners, so people turn on the wrong burner
entries.redesign: Arrange the knobs in the same 2×2 pattern as the burners, and add a lit 'hot' ring on the knob of each active burner
entries.prior_art: Staggered-knob ranges; induction hobs with per-zone touch controls

entries.complaint: The serrated cutter loses the film's edge, the wrap clings to itself, and the blade cuts fingers
entries.redesign: A refillable slide-cutter box with a guide that holds the cut edge at the slot, plus standard refill core sizes

entries.complaint: The tab tears off or the foil rips partway, and food splashes or the user gets cut
entries.redesign: A full-width pull ring bonded through the whole seal, a rolled safe edge on tins, and a peel line that guides the tear around the rim

entries.complaint: Once opened, the bag can't be resealed and the food goes stale
entries.redesign: A peel-and-press adhesive reseal strip below the tear line on every family-size bag

entries.complaint: Locking tabs snap off and lids stop sealing or don't fit
entries.redesign: A gasket and lid in one piece with no hinged tabs; one lid size for each footprint across the whole set; replacement lids sold separately

entries.complaint: Water and icemaker lines run through usable space, freeze, or take up shelf room
entries.redesign: Run the water and icemaker lines inside the cabinet wall with a heated sleeve, and give the icemaker a removable module

entries.complaint: Ceiling lights sit behind the cook and throw shadows onto the worktop
entries.redesign: Wall cabinets sold with an integrated under-cabinet LED channel and plug-through wiring as standard, not as an add-on
